The official Amazon Black Friday sale is officially underway and we have now collected all of the best Apple deals – there’s a ton of them. Alongside AirPods Pro 3 at $70 off and AirPods Max 2 now at $120 off, the new Beats 360 modular ANC headphones are now $100 off (all-time low) and the entire Apple Watch Series 12 lineup is at the lowest prices ever. 

On the Mac side of things, we are tracking a wildly rare $50 price drop on MacBook Neo from $649, the best prices in months on M5 MacBook Air at $250 off, and the very first deals on Apple’s brand new M6 MacBook Pro and PROLED XDR MacBook Pro at up to $250 off. All of that joins a host of accessories, loads of price drops on chargers, and even the very first deal on the super popular new Twelve South’s AirFly Drive Wireless CarPlay Adapter at $32.
